functions.name: core_uid_read
functions.brief: Read the 96-bit unique device ID as three 32-bit words.

params.name: out
params.description: Destination for the three words: out[0] is the first UID word,

functions.name: core_uid_hash
functions.brief: Fold the full 96-bit ID into a single stable 32-bit value (the three words XORed together). Better mixed than any single word — use it to derive short tokens (e.g. a 4-hex-digit name suffix) where the raw low bytes might be correlated across a manufacturing batch.

functions.name: core_uid_hex
functions.brief: Format the full 96-bit ID as an uppercase hex string (24 hex characters, word 0 first, most-significant nibble first within each word) plus a NUL terminator. The canonical form for a device serial number.

params.name: buflen
params.description: Size of buf; must be at least 25.
